title: Token Optimization and Context Window Management in Multi-Agent AI Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2608.17188v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-agent AI workflows are limited not only by model quality but by token cost, latency, and context-window quality. This paper presents a practitioner framework for token optimization and context-window management, grounded in an internal production dashboard that extracts structured work items from meetings, email, and chat with LLMs and routes summaries across workstreams. Six patterns are described: context stratification, fetch-once/process-locally architecture, schema-contracted prompts, token-aware fallback chains, semantic caching, and inter-agent communication compression. In production they cut measured cold-load latency to 61-116 seconds (six timed runs) from an operational baseline of roughly 3.5-10.5 minutes, with an estimated 60-70% token reduction. It also reports a controlled context-composition study: 2,420 confirmatory trials across 11 model configurations, using 661 anonymized workplace items scored for relevance.

translated_title: 多智能体AI工作流中的令牌优化与上下文窗口管理
translated_abstract: 多智能体AI工作流不仅受模型质量限制，还受令牌成本、延迟和上下文窗口质量的影响。本文提出一个面向实践者的令牌优化与上下文窗口管理框架，基于内部生产仪表板，该仪表板利用LLM从会议、电子邮件和聊天中提取结构化工作项，并在各工作流间路由摘要。描述了六种模式：上下文分层、一次获取/本地处理架构、模式约束提示、令牌感知回退链、语义缓存和智能体间通信压缩。在生产中，他们将测得的冷加载延迟从约3.5-10.5分钟的操作基线降低到61-116秒（六次计时运行），估计令牌减少60-70%。文章还报告了一项受控的上下文组合研究：在11种模型配置下进行了2,420次确认性试验，使用661个匿名工作场所项目进行相关性评分。
tldr: 本文提出了一套包含六种模式的令牌优化与上下文窗口管理框架，在生产中实现了60-70%的令牌减少和显著延迟降低，并通过大规模受控试验验证了其有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a framework with six patterns for token optimization and context-window management, achieving 60-70% token reduction and significant latency improvement in production, validated by large-scale controlled trials.
